requirement: Add double time: every hour above 60 is now paid at 2 times the rate instead of 1.5 times. Hours 41 to 60 stay at 1.5 times the rate (that part is still rounded down to a whole cent); the double-time part is (hours - 60) * rate_cents * 2.
desc: Compute each employee's pay in cents: the first 40 hours are paid at rate_cents per hour; hours 41 to 60 are overtime, paid at 1.5 times the rate; every hour above 60 is double time, paid at 2 times the rate. For an employee with more than 40 hours, overtime pay is (min(hours, 60) - 40) * rate_cents * 3 / 2 rounded down to a whole cent, and for an employee with more than 60 hours, double-time pay is (hours - 60) * rate_cents * 2; both are computed separately for each employee before any summing. Return one (dept, total pay) pair per department that has at least one employee, ordered by total pay (highest first), then by department name in ascending code-point order.

decls.ts: type Employee = { name: string; dept: string; hours: number; rate_cents: number };
